world.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
world.description: Asked about the Iranian offer, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

world.title: Russia targeting 'ordinary life' with attacks on Ukraine's data centres, Zelensky says
world.description: Such strikes aim to disrupt "people's ability to stay connected, study, work", says Ukraine's president.

world.title: South African white genocide does not exist, new ambassador to US tells BBC
world.description: Roelf Meyer tells the BBC that being a white Afrikaner gives him legitimacy to challenge Trump's claim of a genocide.

world.title: Inside the FBI hack: Agents fearful and angry after 'dangerous' data breach
world.description: Current and former agents speak to the BBC about the devastating impact of the FBI hack.

world.title: OpenAI investigating 'dozens' of instances of agents acting improperly
world.description: OpenAI agents tried to get information from "governments, universities, public agencies, and other institutions" through extreme means that sometimes curbed security controls, the company said.

world.title: Black woman found hanging from tree was dead before body was 'staged', police say
world.description: Tasia Fortune's body was found hanging from a tree on the grounds of an abandoned home in Jackson in August.

world.title: Pope warns against 'losing humanity' to AI machines
world.description: The pontiff delivered the warning on the first day of his trip to France on Friday.

world.title: Two arrested after people seen mysteriously emerging from various New York City sewers
world.description: The city has seen a string of incidents in which people have climbed out of manholes late at night.

world.title: Supreme Court allows Trump to use controversial database to check voter citizenship
world.description: Critics have questioned the reliability of the data, warning it could  result in US citizens being wrongly removed from electoral rolls.

world.title: Trump's plans for massive arch move ahead
world.description: Opposition to building the 250-foot arch, and using it for military purposes, is growing with one Democrat blasting Trump's plans as "foolhardy".

world.title: Students strike across Germany in protest against military service
world.description: A law establishing voluntary military service came into effect in January, but protest organisers fear compulsory service could follow.

world.title: Man shot during 2024 Trump campaign rally in Butler dies
world.description: A gunman shot Jim Copenhaver twice while also killing another man and grazing Trump's ear with a bullet.

world.title: Xi got Trump's red carpet welcome - but not everything he wanted
world.description: China wanted progress on trade, technology and Taiwan - but hasn't got as much as it would have hoped for.

world.title: Senior Kazakh officials detained after 14 service members swept out to sea
world.description: Seventeen service members were swept out to the Caspian Sea during military exercises.

world.title: Jay-Z rape accuser says her allegation was false
world.description: A woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 now says she has never met the rap superstar.

US.title: Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed Missouri congressional map
US.description: The ruling is a defeat for Republicans seeking to give their party an edge in the midterm elections for control of the House. It means voters will face a different map than the one used in the primary

US.title: The Pacific is churning with hurricanes. The Atlantic is quiet. Blame El Niño
US.description: The Pacific Ocean has had an unusual number of storms this year, while the Atlantic hasn't recorded a single full-blown hurricane. Scientists point to an exceptionally strong El Niño.

US.title: Takeaways from the Trump-Xi state visit: Pageantry and pandas
US.description: The visit comes at an important time for both men.

US.title: Woman who accused Jay-Z of sexual assault says her claims were false
US.description: On Thursday, the woman identified as Jane Doe filed a declaration in Manhattan federal court stating that all of her original claims against the rapper were false.

US.title: There's a global pandemic treaty that's signed -- and in 'limbo.' What's the holdup?
US.description: The treaty aims to help the countries of the world prepare for — and defeat — any future pandemic. Why hasn't it gone into effect?

US.title: The Supreme Court revives a controversial data system for citizenship checks
US.description: The Supreme Court is allowing use of a data system that Trump officials overhauled. The system has erroneously flagged U.S. citizens and a lower court found it violated federal privacy protections.

US.title: Pope Leo warns a 'paradise of machines' could undermine humanity on his France visit
US.description: Pope Leo XIV raised existential concerns about scientific progress, life and human rights during a speech on his first papal visit to France.

US.title: Hurricane Nolo, a zig-zagging storm, threatens Hawaii with flooding rains
US.description: Nolo will slow down as it nears Hawaii's Big Island and is expected to become a major hurricane this weekend, bringing torrential rain to areas that have been flooded by big storms this summer.

US.title: Trump and Xi strike cordial tone at summit. And, Netanyahu gives defiant UNGA speech
US.description: Trump and Xi's U.S. summit continues after a state dinner Thursday night. And, Netanyahu returns to Israel after giving a defensive and defiant speech at the U.N. General Assembly.

US.title: Why this Pokémon set is dropping in value
US.description: How does one price a cemetery plot? Are they using dynamic pricing to figure it out? We tackle that question and many more in this week's Indicator newsletter.
